A light that stops working, a door that gets stuck, or a technical issue at one of the housing locations: there is always something that needs attention. As an Assistant Technical Employee, you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and solving these issues together with the technical team. Salary

Location 
 Etten-Leur 
Employment type 
 Full-time 
 What will you do? 
As an Assistant Technical Employee, you support the technical team with maintaining and improving the housing locations, facilities, and equipment. You help with daily maintenance and repair tasks and carry out preventive maintenance to avoid technical problems as much as possible. 
Do you notice a technical issue while working? You identify and report it and help solve simple mechanical and electrical problems. You also make sure that tools and work areas are clean, organized, and safe. You work closely with the Technical Service team and, when needed, with external contractors. You always follow the safety procedures and company guidelines. For business trips to the different housing locations, a car is provided. 
 The offer 
What do you get? - A gross monthly salary of €2,652; - A dynamic and supportive working environment; - Opportunities for training and professional development; - A car for business trips to the different housing locations; - A varied role where you can gain plenty of practical experience. 
 Job requirements 
What do you bring to the role? - You are handy, practical, and eager to learn new things; - You have a valid driving licence; - You have at least a B1 level of English; - Experience in a similar technical role is a plus, but not required; - You can work both independently and as part of a team.
